extraction_notes: HEICO's 10-K is notable for the ABSENCE of specific Pentagon Program Element (PE) references. As an aerospace aftermarket parts company (60% FSG commercial-aviation-heavy + 40% ETG with ~49% defense exposure in ETG), the filing describes capability categories (TWTAs, RF/microwave, EW systems, simulation) and end-platforms (satellites, spacecraft, missiles) rather than naming PE numbers, contract vehicles, or named DoD programs of record. The only specifically named DoD program in the entire MD&A/Item 1 narrative is the F-16 fighter aircraft. This itself is a finding for the J-Book divergence cohort: HEICO's defense narrative is structurally diversified across hundreds of low-PE-concentration positions, which makes J-Book-grounded shorting structurally hard. Most claims below are therefore CATEGORY-LEVEL or REVENUE-AGGREGATE claims; only one (F-16) is a true J-Book-grounded named-program claim. We also include two control claims (acquisition / counterparty) per the rubric.

claims.claim_text: FSG is a leading provider of products and services necessary to maintain up-to-date F-16 fighter aircraft operational capabilities.
claims.subject: HEICO FSG
claims.object_value: F-16 fighter aircraft (USAF program of record, also operated by 25+ FMS partners)
claims.source_quote: Further, we believe the FSG is a leading provider of products and services necessary to maintain up-to-date F-16 fighter aircraft operational capabilities.

claims.claim_text: ETG designs and manufactures TWTAs (traveling wave tube amplifiers) and MPMs (microwave power modules) predominately used in radar, electronic warfare, on-board jamming and countermeasure systems in aircraft, ships and detection platforms deployed by U.S. and allied non-U.S. military forces.

claims.source_quote: The ETG designs and manufactures TWTAs and MPMs predominately used in radar, electronic warfare, on-board jamming and countermeasure systems in aircraft, ships and detection platforms deployed by U.S. and allied non-U.S. military forces.

claims.claim_text: ETG produces RF/microwave products (isolators, ferrite switches, custom high power filters, converters, receivers, transmitters, amplifiers, frequency sources) used in both commercial and military satellites, spacecraft and in electronic warfare systems; HEICO believes it is a leading supplier into the satellite/stand-off-warfare market.
claims.subject: HEICO ETG
claims.object_value: military satellites, spacecraft, electronic warfare systems
claims.source_quote: Our microwave products are used in both commercial and military satellites, spacecraft and in electronic warfare systems. ... As satellites are frequently used as sensors for stand-off warfare, we believe this product line further supports our goal of increasing our activity in the stand-off market.

claims.claim_text: ETG memory products (3D stacked microelectronic memory, SRAM, EEPROM) are principally integrated into larger subsystems equipping satellites and spacecraft.
claims.subject: HEICO ETG
